 4 and 5 : Mr. Tiwari Shwetketu, Advocate  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE RAJIV ROY

2. The present petition has been preferred for the following relief/s:
(i) to issue an appropriate writ in the nature of certiorari or any other appropriate writ, order or direction quashing the order dated 25.08.2017 passed by the Learned District Judge, Rohtas, Sasaram in Civil Misc. Case No.78/14 whereby the application filed by the petitioners under Section 5 of Limitation Act for condonation of delay in filing the Misc. Case under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 has been rejected and the Misc. Case has been dismissed'
(ii) for the issuance of an appropriate writ Patna High Court CWJC No.15921 of 2017(2) dt.05-05-2025 in the nature of mandamus or any other appropriate writ,
order or direction commanding upon the authorities of the Special Railway Project,
Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor Corporation of India Limited to calculate and fix the compensation payable to the petitioners for acquisition of their lands as per the new Entitlement Matrix for dedicated freight corridor in accordance with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the 2013 Act) which has been approved by the Railway Board for the Dedicated Freight Corridor;
Murli Singh And Ors vs The Union Of India And Ors on 5 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11696868/
1 (iii) for the issuance of an appropriate writ, order or direction setting aside the award dated 28.8.2013 made by Competent Authority appointed under the provisions of the Railways Act,1989 whereby compensation payable to the petitioners has Patna High Court CWJC No.15921 of 2017(2) dt.05-05-2025 been calculated in terms of the old policy/guidelines of the government with regard to evaluation of the market value as well as the amount of compensation to be paid to the persons whose lands are acquired;
(iv) for issuance of an appropriate writ, order or direction commanding upon the District Land Acquisition Officer, Rohtas, Sasaram, being the Competent Authority for the acquisition of lands under the Eastern Dedicated Freight Corridor to re-evaluate the market value of the land of the petitioners acquired for abovementioned Dedicated Freight Corridor and further to calculate the compensation payable to the petitioners in terms of the existing guidelines more so in view of the fact that payment of the amount of compensation calculated under the earlier guidelines was made to the petitioners after coming into effect of the 2013 Act;
Patna High Court CWJC No.15921 of 2017(2) dt.05-05-2025 (v) for the grant of any other relief or reliefs to which the petitioners are entitled to in the facts and circumstances of the case and in the interests of justice.
3. Admit.
4. The State represents respondent nos. 6 and 7 and respondent nos. 2 to 5 are appeared and as such no notice is required.
5.
